text:
Mira: Heads-up — target cutover tonight 21:00 PT. Need a quick alignment on version pinning + rollback plan for API, runtime, console, router. Change window 21:00-23:00 PT. Please ack and call out blockers.

deploy-bot: Change window scheduled: 2026-03-20 21:00-23:00 PT. Affected services: api, runtime, console, router. Auto checks: lint, smoke, canary. Use /deploy to run.

Alex: ack. Runtime questions: 1) Any KV-cache schema changes? 2) Do we need to prewarm dedicated GPU pool?

Devon: ack. I'll pin API to v2.9.1 (stable) and keep v2.9.0-rc2 as fallback. No breaking wire changes on our side, just a minor timeout tweak.

Sam: console ack. We have a small DB column add (nullable) for session metadata. Migration is online, takes ~2m, safe to run during window. We'll start migration at T+5m after canary passes.

Jen: SRE note — prewarm yes for runtime. Recommend bumping runtime min-replicas to 6 for 30m before the cutover, and set GPU prewarm to 80% capacity. I'll run the commands 20:30 PT.

Jen: Prewarm commands: ```sh
# scale runtime pool
kubectl scale deploy/runtime-pool -n prod --replicas=6
# prewarm script
/scripts/prewarm-gpu --pool runtime-pool --target 0.8
```

Alex: KV-cache: no schema change, but we should invalidate prefix cache for `models/v1/*` after the runtime deploy to avoid stale prompts. Plan: flush those keys in the final step.

Devon: Router note — sticky session TTL is currently 10m. When we do traffic shift, keep 50% canary for 10m then 100% if health looks good. Router config change is a simple rollout to allow sticky routing to new backend tag.

Mira: Proposed rollout plan:
1) 21:00 — smoke + lint checks (deploy-bot)
2) 21:05 — deploy API v2.9.1 -> canary 10% for 5m
3) 21:10 — deploy runtime v3.2.1 -> canary 10% for 5m, prewarm already up
4) 21:20 — run console DB migration (Sam) at 21:20 PT
5) 21:30 — shift router to 50% for 10m -> monitor
6) 21:45 — full traffic if no regressions.

Mira: Rollback plan (if canary fails): revert service to previous pinned tag and run cache flush + diag. Use the following rollback sequence.

deploy-bot: rollback commands (manual trigger):
```bash
# rollback runtime to prior release
/deploy rollback runtime v3.2.0 --reason "canary-failure" --force
# rollback api
/deploy rollback api v2.9.0-rc2 --reason "canary-failure"
# router revert
kubectl set image ds/router router=image:stable -n prod
```

Alex: I'll add a quick health-check script to check KV hit-rate and tail latency during canary.

Sam: Console will post migration logs to #incidents stream and tag this thread.

Devon: One more ask — can we pin the API contract in the gateway for the next 24h to block automatic minor schema upgrades? I’ll open a gate rule.

Mira: Yes — gate rule approved. I will pin the versions in the release manifest: runtime=v3.2.1, api=v2.9.1, console=v1.18.0, router=stable+config-20260320.

Jen: I'll watch infra metrics and keep a runbook open. If anything hits error-rate > 2x baseline during canary, we rollback immediately.

Alex: acked. I'll flush `models/v1/*` keys at the final step if we fully cutover.

Devon: ack — I'll set canary ramp policy: 10% -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (manual).

Mira: Thanks all. Final checklist: pins set in manifest, prewarm at 20:30 PT (Jen), smoke + canary at 21:00, migration at 21:20, rollback commands ready. If no objections, we proceed.

Alex: no objections.

Sam: good to go.

Jen: ready.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled at 20:25 PT to run prewarm step and at 20:55 PT to run smoke checks. :white_check_mark:

Mira: closing thread — will post final status after 23:00 PT. :rocket:
